intro: Call of Water is a quest tasking travelers with journeying to Stonewatch Falls in Redridge to investigate suspected corruption in the runoff from Lake Everstill. By filling an Empty Red Waterskin and returning it to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands, shamans uncover the true source behind mutated local murlocs while securing a key reagent for their spiritual trials.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.
Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, this is good water, friend. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed prove you're ready for the next stage of your journey.
One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
